properties.query:
let detectionWindow = 1h;
let signinLookback = 1h;
let baselineEnd = detectionWindow + signinLookback;
let UserBaseline = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(baselineEnd))
| where ResultType == 0
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where isnotempty(Country)
| summarize UsualCountries = make_set(Country) by UserPrincipalName;
let PIMActivations = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(detectionWindow)
| where OperationName == "Add member to role completed (PIM activation)"
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| where isnotempty(Actor)
| extend Role = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
        ActivationIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| project ActivationTime = TimeGenerated, Actor, Role, ActivationIP;
let CandidateSignins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(baselineEnd)
| where ResultType == 0
| project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AuthenticationRequirement,
    Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), IPAddress;
PIMActivations
| join kind=inner CandidateSignins on $left.Actor == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where SigninTime between ((ActivationTime - signinLookback) .. ActivationTime)
| extend MatchScore = iff(isnotempty(ActivationIP) and IPAddress == ActivationIP, 1, 0)
| summarize arg_max(SigninTime, AuthenticationRequirement, Country, IPAddress) by ActivationTime, Actor, Role, MatchScore
| summarize arg_max(MatchScore, *) by ActivationTime, Actor, Role
| extend CorrelationMethod = iff(MatchScore == 1, "Same IP as activation", "Time-window heuristic")
| join kind=leftouter UserBaseline on $left.Actor == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where AuthenticationRequirement != "multiFactorAuthentication"
    or (isnotempty(Country) and array_length(UsualCountries) > 0 and not(set_has_element(UsualCountries, Country)))
| project ActivationTime, Actor, Role, SigninTime, Country, IPAddress, AuthenticationRequirement, CorrelationMethod, UsualCountries
properties.name: PIM Role Activation After Sign-In Without MFA or From New Country
properties.description:
'Detects Privileged Identity Management (PIM) role activations where the
preceding sign-in did not use MFA, or came from a country not seen for that
user in the prior 14 days. Either condition alone triggers the alert.
The sign-in is linked to the activation heuristically: the sign-in from the
same IP as the activation is preferred, otherwise the user''s most recent
successful sign-in in the hour before the activation is used. The
CorrelationMethod column shows which was applied. Users with no location
baseline, or a sign-in with no country, are not evaluated for the location condition.'
